about_the_game:
Outsmart your opponent in this turn-based card battler! Master the unique timeframe mechanic - calculate when to take some risks, and exploit your opponent's hasty decisions. Explore a range of playable fighters, each of whom has their own move set, and many come with unique mechanics.

Engage in Stage Fighting, a popular activity enjoyed by many from various backgrounds across this fictional Empire. For their own reasons, the fighters found themselves in this major city under the Empire's ruling. They came from a variety of professions and experiences - peacekeepers, actors, builders, and many more.

LITE version features

  • New player guidance with Assistant

  • Play with/against 4 distinct fighters

  • Add some house rules

  • Play against Assistant

  • Play against other LITE version players

  • Complete quests and obtain new content exchange tickets. Not super useful in LITE but they can be carried over to the FULL version.

  • In sync with all quality of life improvements in FULL version

FULL version features (on top of LITE version)

  • Play with/against 8 extra fighters that can be unlocked over time

  • Unlock new ways to play via expansions

  • Earn in-game currency while playing the game and spend them on new stuff

  • Play against other FULL version players

  • Customize your stage with items you've obtained

  • Steam Deck support
